This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Oliver has been observed to be highly fearful while in care. Noted to retreat from handlers and during his assessment he was not receptive to treats. During intake Oliver head whipped and snapped at handlers when they attempted to place him in his top kennel. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Oliver
